title: [P PRIVATE GO] Measure the next reusable scoped-writer composition
body:
## C RELEASE · existing sole P · bounded private continuation

This starts after the same P has POSTed and individually verified the exact #1786 PUBLIC HANDOFF for [Draft #1789](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/pull/1789) HEAD `bcc0592fe95f4518c608f8e9dc54ca0090ee70ad` and confirmed the live pins. Adopted main `637653d917d1bc63acece382f0e014df3ae19e02`, [CURRENT_SPEC → Draft17.38](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/blob/637653d917d1bc63acece382f0e014df3ae19e02/docs/reference/CURRENT_SPEC.md), original adopted Required8 raw audited. The public Draft is a separate comparison pin under C/F/R and natural CI. An important #1789 or actual-main finding takes priority.

- **Goal.** Choose one practical reuse need for the ordinary scoped writer or a higher-value nearby compiler dependency faithful to selected semantics. A possible case is a library reusing the same byte exchange on independently live queue descriptors whose target fields have different declared positions or nominal layouts. Diagnose which compatibility constraint actually matters for an ordinary caller. Another concrete use case or an existing supported formulation is valid. P chooses the case and scope within the bounded authority. Reuse previous single/same-original, literal/current/old-byte routes as applicable.
- **Evidence.** Begin with frozen ordinary CLI Gate0, actual field/original/call identities, scope and cleanup, and first refusal or measured success. Compare the already supported routes and well-factored C at the same API, original physical storage and failure contract. State what the library author and ordinary-safe caller must audit and re-audit for UB prevention and what remains the caller's policy.
- **Authority.** One bounded private increment using existing checked issuer, authentic replays, cleanup and place model. P is the implementation captain and picks design, resources, local repair, iterations and verification under [Process §4.1.2](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/blob/637653d917d1bc63acece382f0e014df3ae19e02/docs/NewLang_Project_Development_Process.md#412-各trackの裁量と認可scope内の自律反復). New semantics, authority, public API/ABI/issuer, material investment and publication require C. A measured NO CHANGE is a valid result.
- **STOP and custody.** Material predecessor/main failure, unsafe or wrong behavior, inconsistent source/original/owner/issuer/scope, OOM/rollback/no-clobber, or evidence loss. Preserve FIRST, first outcomes, prior pins and archive manifests. Keep independent F/R inputs isolated. POST and individually GET ACTUAL and FIRST before measured work, then LOCAL READY or NO CHANGE/STOP.

[Adopted main evidence](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/1782#issuecomment-7158561682) · [#1786 integrated local report](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/1786#issuecomment-7158334207) · [Value §1.1](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/blob/637653d917d1bc63acece382f0e014df3ae19e02/docs/NewLang_Product_Value_Strategy.md#11-ub-prevention-audit-locality-value-hypothesis). Limited Exploration, Product GO #624 PAUSED and H1 HOLD.
